title: Axos Financial, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Axos Financial, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing that its subsidiary Axos Bank entered into a purchase and assumption agreement with Capital One on April 22, 2026 to acquire individual retirement accounts (IRAs) with approximately $3.2 billion in aggregate balances, along with associated savings and certificate of deposit accounts. The acquisition requires OCC approval and is expected to close in late 2026.
key_points: Axos Bank (subsidiary of Axos Financial, Inc.) agreed to acquire ~$3.2 billion in IRA balances from Capital One
Transaction structured as purchase and assumption agreement; Bank receives cash for deposit balance less a negotiated premium
Acquisition includes associated savings and CD accounts with related assets and liabilities
Subject to Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) approval
Expected closing: later in calendar year 2026
Signed by Derrick K. Walsh, EVP and CFO, on April 23, 2026
